lines.text: Perfect. That’s what we need. Keep it somewhere safe.

That night, I helped recover an important tape for a client I later learnt was MI6, and I’m glad it was MI6 on that radio because I really would have just trusted whoever on that thing and done whatever they asked…
Regardless, they pulled me into their training program - six months late I might add.
Are you talking to someone? Your heart rate is dropping. Stay put. We’ll send a rescue team…
